name: Sketch Battle — Multibot Bowl v0.5
description: Scan pupils' battlebots with a paired phone, place wheels and animated weapons, then use Add Bot or Add All for 2–30 simultaneous combatants in the bowl; 1v1 classroom tournaments remain available.

name: Sketch Boat (Prototype)
description: Draw a boat and race automatically in an early top-down water-physics prototype.

name: Sketch Boat
description: Draw or scan boats with a paired phone host, create custom waterways and race automatically. Powerboat and sailing challenges included.

name: Sketch Moto
description: Draw your own dirt bike, then race 10 automatic motocross challenges or score freestyle stunts.

name: Pipe Masters
description: Team up with coloured paper strips to complete a pipeline using a webcam.

name: BoatBeats
description: Race your boat by clapping along with musical beats.

name: Sketch Rally
description: Turn your own car design into a racer for hill-climb challenges.

name: Sketch Rally Online
description: Log in with your pupil or tester code, draw with the original Sketch Rally studio, choose a track and watch your car race automatically. School leaderboard included.

name: Melody Trail
description: Listen, imitate melodies and practice beats, singing and instrument sounds.

name: STEM Battleship
description: Answer STEM questions to power your battleship and outmaneuver your opponent.

name: Motion Quest
description: Use coloured cards to guide a character through obstacles.

name: Boxing Game
description: A webcam-powered boxing game for the smartboard.
